tweet_summary: Barstool Sports promotional tweet posted ~7 hours before midnight launch announcing DraftKings Sportsbook is 'LIVE' in Missouri with a $300 bonus-bets offer.
why_note_decision: DraftKings genuinely launched Missouri mobile sportsbook on December 1, 2025 at 12:00 AM CT — the tweet was posted Nov 30 at 22:22 UTC (~4:22 PM CT), about 7.5 hours before official launch. Treating a 'launch announcement' tweet as misinformation because it preceded the actual moment of go-live by hours is trivial pedantry; promotional marketing of imminent launches is standard practice. No reader is materially misled.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. This is a sponsorship/marketing tweet about a legitimate sportsbook launch that occurred ~7 hours later (Dec 1, 2025 12:00 AM CT in Missouri). FAIL any note that 'corrects' the timing by citing the exact midnight launch — pedantic on a marketing announcement. FAIL any note framing the promotional bonus offer as misleading without evidence the offer terms are deceptive.

original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: noteNotNeeded — pedantic timing nitpick on a marketing post; launch did occur as scheduled hours later.

fact_check.claim_verdict: DraftKings Missouri launch confirmed for Dec 1, 2025 12:00 AM CT — tweet posted ~7.5 hours prior as promotional buildup; 'is LIVE' framing is marketing copy for imminent launch, not a misleading factual claim.
fact_check.notes: DraftKings did launch Missouri as scheduled and held a ceremonial first-bet event Dec 1 at The Palladium in St. Louis.

importance.lens_rationale: Only 1.6k impressions, no public-harm dimension. Important pipeline-learning case for not over-correcting timing on promotional/marketing posts.
